title: The Church: missions, Jesuits and universities
goal: Read how the Church shaped the colony, from missions to universities, and use para que with the subjunctive to say why people did things.

items: Use *para que* + subjunctive to say why one person did something for another.
Say what the Jesuits founded among the Guaraní and what happened to them in 1767.
Say what was installed in Mexico City in 1539.
Say who Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz was.
Use the key words of the Church: missionary, bishop, university, printing press and nun.
